name: Computer Organization & Assembly Language
summary: How a computer is built from logic gates up to a working processor, and how programs look at the machine level in assembly language.

topics.name: Number systems: binary, hexadecimal and two's complement
Combinational circuits: multiplexers, decoders, adders and the ALU
Sequential circuits: latches, flip-flops, registers and counters
The von Neumann architecture and the fetch-decode-execute cycle
Instruction set architectures: RISC-V, ARM and x86
Assembly programming: registers, arithmetic and branches
Procedures, the stack and calling conventions
Memory hierarchy overview: registers, cache, RAM and disk
Building a computer from NAND gates (Nand2Tetris-style project)
